RUNNER UP WANTS A TORCH, TOO
WHY DO I NEED A TRASH TRUCK?
You don't see a lot of these...  The Temptress is stylish, agile, and very, very fast. People pay top-dollar for these machines.  I will, too, yah?  Try looking around the strip in New Baranec.

There's a group in town called the Crusade for Urban Morality.  They're a modern-day Inquisition run by some chick named Agnes.  [format][color:em]A little streaking[/format] by her HQ near [format][color:em] the church in Ashwood[/format] oughtta bring that repressive bitch out.
This one is the big score.  STAG's heavy lifter could make somebody the ultimate getaway vehicle.  The Condor is well-guarded, but you can find one near their Base in Sunset Park.
GOT A REQUEST FOR A HEAVY LIFTING STORK
Chop Shop contract accepted. Once you finish your current mission or activity, GPS will enable.

Good day.  My name isn't important.  What IS important is how Chandler's ambulance-chasing practice takes advantage of Steelport's victims. Taking him out would be a civic improvement, for which you'll be compensated.  Stage an accident downtown ... [format][color:em] get a car to run you over[/format] ... and you'll find him.
Call them up to deliver Danny, your assassination target (and a free pizza).
A very big client needs a Tornado to help him win a very little war.  Check the Guard Base for one.

Killbane's publicist, Whitney, needs to disappear, but we don't want this one tied to us.  Her people would destroy us in the press if they figure it out.  A plane crash won't leave much evidence.  [format][color:em]Pick her up at the airport gate[/format], Fly her up, then [format][color:em]jump out and leave her behind[/format].
The Stork can transport just about anything... smuggled goods, smuggled people, smuggled goods IN smuggled people.  Get one in or around the airport.
This particular Torch is Steelport's street racing champion.  Now the sore-loser second-place finisher wants it.  You're gunna find it around Ashwood.

Gerrard was dirty as a wrestler, but he's even worse since he left the ring.  Much of the Luchadores' shadiest business passes through him. [format][color:em]Pull up to his gas station in a car he'll admire ... he likes muscle cars[/format], then kill him.  No need to keep this one subtle.  Blow up the whole station if you want.
TAKE THE SHOPKEEPER TO GET THE CASH
Because sometimes you just need to take out the trash.  These hunks of municipal steel roam the streets all over in the wee hours of the morning.

District Attorney Hess is planning to run for mayor.  This town already has the only one it needs.  Catch up with him at [format][color:em] the federal courthouse in Henry Mills[/format], and I'm sure you can change his mind.
REQUIRE A COMMANDER FOR A CLIENT
You want to roll in this town, baby, you gotta learn to pimp your ride!  And who knows that better than the finest pimp in Steelport?
You have agreed to eliminate a target for someone. Read their description of the job for clues on how to find and/or draw out the target at the designated location.
Money makes the world move.  If we can cut off the other guys' cash from their operations, we'll be closer to running this town

We specialize in air vehicles and watercraft, and we have an opening for someone in acquisitions.  We can start small.  Snag a Shark and bring it to the dock, and we'll talk more. Try up near Camano Place Waterfront.

Luther's a creepy-ass sex-fiend.  Hey, world's full of 'em, right?  Except he keeps comin' on to me every time he sees me in [format][color:em]Loren Square[/format]. Do me a favor and remove him from circulation. His twisted ass'll approach anybody who seems friendly, so just [format][color:em] compliment a bunch of people[/format].
Maximum Respect for this Diversion has been reached. You will now be rewarded Cash, in place of Respect.

I run the working man's chop-shop in town, and I need something big on power and short on brakes.  This tricked-out Bootlegger is worth its weight in chrome, if you can find it.  The owner usually hangs around Rosen Oaks.
One Player (Cat) chases and tries to kill the other Player (Mouse) as they flee to checkpoints as fast as possible.
These street cleaners keep Steelport's streets and casino parking lots free of trash, blood and puke.  You can find 'em pretty much anywhere Downtown late at night.

Michael is a former DA who now works for the Deckers.  He's not only totally crooked, he pretty much wrote the book on identity protection.  I have a copy, it's not bad actually...  I know he drives to work, so I'm thinking you can [format][color:em]grab a police car[/format] and pull him over somewhere in [format][color:em]Ashwood[/format].
YOU GOT TALENT, I GOT WORK. LET'S BANK A BOOTLEGGER
It isn't a street race without a Neuron, which kinda makes their parts high-demand items.  Look for them around the Henry Steel Mills.

Randall works in security at [format][color:em] the Three Count[/format].  He also helps himself to the take.  Cause a little trouble up around that casino ... [format][color:em]assault some patrons or something[/format] ... to draw him out, and  you can make Steelport safe for honest gamblers.

I can't take it anymore!!!  Our pizza delivery guy IS STUPID!!! Every order is WRONG!!!  [format][color:em]Try it, go to Yearwood then use your phone to order something!!![/format] It's SO FRUSTRATING!!!  I WANT MY PIZZA!!!  Stop this MADNESS and [format][color:em]KILL THIS IDIOT[/format] before I GO INSANE!!!

This thing's a seagoing enforcer.  It's just as good for chasing waterborne perps as it is cruising the Mekong Delta.  And smugglers love 'em, too.  You can always find a Commander docked off Sierra Point ... that's the Guard base just north of the big statue.

Here at Humanitarian Aid, Inc., we think it's unfair that STAG has these monsters and our clients don't.  Help even the odds.  If you don't know how to get one of these N-Forcers after you by now, you're doing something wrong.
RIGG'S SEA-AIR SUPPLIES HAS AN OPENING FOR A REAL SHARK

I am pleased with your work, but there is more to do.  Mr. Dickson is a prominent figure in the organization.  He is an arrogant man who refused to ride in anything but a limo.  You will [format][color:em]wait for him in a limo[/format] near his office at [format][color:em]Loren Square[/format].  See to it that Mr. Dickson retires early.
TAKE A COMPENSATOR TO PAY DEBTS
So my shop keeps the best parts in stock for Steelport's tuners.  You can start with a Halberd.  It's short on headroom, but entry-level tuners can make it fly, ya know?  Look around Brickston.

Some hot-shot mechanic named Clovis's been beatin' on my hos and I can't be havin' that.  Bad for morale, know what I'm sayin'?  How 'bout you make sure my girls can work in peace?  Shame to lose a good mechanic, though.  You oughta [format][color:em]get some work done[/format] before you lay him out. He hangs at Rim Jobs in [format][color:em]Camano Place[/format].
Sun Tzu once said 'The natural formation of the country is the soldier's best ally.'  This applies to Steelport as well.  Find shortcuts throughout the city.
SNATCHING THIS VORTEX IS A WIN/WIN

The Syndicate has produced a... sensitive brute.  This defect must be removed.  If you look friendly and [format][color:em]approach with no weapons out[/format], you can get close while he is sniffing flowers[format][color:em] in the park downtown[/format].  I'll be in touch.

Andre's a big-time Morningstar pimp.  Half the hos in this city turn tricks for him.  It's gonna take a lot to draw him out, though. [format][color:em]Take down a whole bunch of his bitches in Espina -- any ho you find there works for him --[/format] AND get [format][color:em]Morningstar as mad as you can get them up there[/format], and you'll be good.

We provide police and military-grade equipment to an exclusive Third World clientele.  We're big-league, but if you can prove yourself by stealing a Lockdown van for us, we'll enlist you further.  Get law enforcement angry and take one from a roadblock.
PICK UP SOME ASPRIN ON THE WAY HOME
We at Friendly Fire are considering offering a grenade sampler for the upcoming holiday rush.  Test some out and let me know if they're worth it.
HUMANITARIAN AID, INC. - LOCKING DOWN INSURGENTS
This particular Miami was featured in the first episode of an '80s hit cop show, and a collector wants it bad.  You can find it around the wharf in Sunset Park.
Try to hold out against waves of enemies. Some waves might be timed, others require a certain number of kills to complete. Each completed wave awards a bonus. Good luck!
While the phrase is overused, the idea behind 'winning over hearts and minds' is sound.  Perhaps you should cultivate some goodwill for the Saints.

Karl hauls bags at the airport.  He also smuggles drugs in them, and ruthlessly steps on anyone in his territory.  [format][color:em]Steal a cart at the airport[/format] and I'm sure he'll come check you out.

Killbane ordered one of these for his boys in a fit of grandiosity, but doesn't have anyone who knows how to fly it.  We'll put this Vulture to better use.  It's parked on a dock near the Three Count.
Nothing bores me faster than a car with all four wheels on the pavement.  You and me are gonna show Steelport what driving's all about!
TRY TO BE MORE CAREFUL AROUND YOUR [format][color:green]CAMERAMAN[/format]

Call me Rasputin.  I'm highly-placed in the Morningstar, but have my reasons for wanting to embarrass the current leadership.  Jake's a cement truck driver who helps bury the bodies.  You'll find him driving around [format][color:em]Salander[/format]. Eliminate him, and I'll trust you with something bigger.
Somebody couldn't pay their gambling debts, so we're taking their Compensator instead as... uh... compensation.  Find it in Yearwood.
Return the vehicle to the chop shop. Drive carefully, the more damaged a vehicle becomes, the less of a payout you'll receive!
European roadster styling meets high resale value in the Vortex, meaning baby, we can't lose on this one.  You can find them in or around Downtown.
Normally I wouldn't ask you to land a plane on the pier, but someone stuffed this Woodpecker with some contraband we need back.  Find it on the tarmac up at Cutter International.

Darling!  Dr. Wang botched my facelift and now I look hideous.  I can't stop smiling at all! [format][color:em]Go in for your own cosmetic surgery at his downtown office[/format] and make sure you're his last patient ever.

Ulysses is a high-end fence and a major source of funds for the Syndicate.  He also loves all kinds of aircraft.  If you [format][color:em]fly around his building[/format],  he's bound to come out and watch.  When he does, kill him.
You tied. Press {PICKUP_RELOAD_IMG} to have it roll over to the next round, or {ACTION_IMG} to quit.
Gas ain't cheap, and with prices going up, the Peterliner's just the thing to bring back a tanker-load of black market fuel.  You can find it in Espina.
FEEL LIKE GRABBING THIS KANEDA FOR ME?
Hitman contract accepted. Once you finish your current mission or activity, GPS will enable.
Listen, sweetie, I'll be blunt.  FUZZ needs crime footage badly, so sometimes you just have to give criminals a little nudge.  'Nudge, Nudge!'
We gotta keep ourselves sharp if we want to survive in Steelport.  Layin' down the hurt fast and furious is one sure way to do that
Johnny liked headshots, but why be lethal when you can hit them where it really hurts?

STAG's got this commando, Sgt. Steiner, who's pretty much a one man killing machine.  Our boys can't touch him.  He's an arrogant sonofabitch, though, and wants a showdown with you. They said you could go to [format][color:em] that big-ass statue[/format] then [format][color:em] call this number[/format].  Grab your best gear and bring that asshole down.
Call the local firefighters to your location, and be ready to finish off your target.
Any newb can do a wheelie.  But stoppies... they're a whole 'nother beast, man.  Let's see if you got what it takes to be Steelport's Cycle King.
BEST TO HAUL A BIG LOAD WITH A PETERLINER
Mint-condition Kanedas bring big bucks on the underground bike racing circuit, if you can catch one.  Try looking in Bridgeport.
Search the city for the desired vehicle. Some are specific vehicles (follow your GPS!), for others, any of the right model will do.
You know, nothing gets people to tune in to FUZZ like a homicidal maniac behind the wheel.  What do you say, can you be that homicidal maniac?
Those 'Xtreme' supercross gearheads can't get enough of the Sandstorm.  That's why they get stolen.  So steal one.  You might try looking around Burns Hill.
You're pretty solid, but nobody's mastered the wheelie like The Speed Phreak!  I'll lay money you're not half as elite as me!
HOLD {ATTACK_SECONDARY_IMG} TO REVIVE IN DEATH TAG DIVERSION
Yes, we want you to steal a Challenger tank.  If it were easy, we wouldn't be paying you as much as we are.  Try near the armory, and expect a lot more guards.
ANOTHER AIRPORT RUN WITH A WOODPECKER

The Oppressor's been the cops' eye in the sky, and a thorn in the side of honest criminals for years.  It's perfect for carrying cops... or framing them.  Get my drift?  The cops usually have one parked and at-the-ready down by the old power plant in Sunset Park.
While perhaps irrational, the impracticality of these little vehicles for someone of my size annoys me.  Why not encourage people to drive something else?
There's a growing market for slightly damaged boats.  Create some, and I'll make it worth yer while.  Might be exaggerating the 'slightly' part...
Responding to Survival Calls is optional ... if you ignore it, it will go away shortly. If you want to help the Saints out, set your GPS to the location and get there quickly!

My faith in you was well placed.  The time has come for you to claim your reward.  The Morningstar are moving a large amount of cash.   Find Grigor, their courier, near  [format][color:em]the Camano Place wharf[/format].  Take from him what is rightfully yours.
You have found all of the jumps! Boosh!

The Luchadores have built their success with imported steroids.  Every week this guy brings them a new shipment.
